ModMetaData.name: Sky Islands: Starjack Patches
ModMetaData.author: JalapenoLabs
ModMetaData.description:
Treats a Sky Islands map as the middle ground it is for space-adapted pawns, instead of the harshest "planetside" case.
Sky islands float at high altitude on a child-of-orbit planet layer that the Sky Islands mod deliberately marks non-space so the maps stay habitable. A side effect is that space-adapted colonists (like starjacks) take full planetary penalties there. This patch softens two of them while on a sky island:
- The shipborn "space habitat" ideoligion mood ("Planetary habitat", -2) becomes neutral: no penalty, and no space bonus. - The "low gravity adapted" gene's planetside move/work penalty is halved.
Both changes apply only while a pawn is on a sky island; everywhere else, vanilla behavior is unchanged. Requires the Odyssey DLC and the Sky Islands mod.
